title: Public profile
lede: A page of your own to show how you study: what AnyLearn counted, which you cannot edit, and a few words of yours. You choose what is on it and who gets the link.
fromProgress: Show it on your public profile
counted: The numbers here are counted by AnyLearn from study recorded in it, through {{date}}. {{name}} cannot edit them.

footer.made: This page is made with AnyLearn, which counts study days from real study.

summary.title: At a glance
summary.about: Study days, the streak, the weekly goal met in a row, and the level.

calendar.title: A year of study
calendar.about: Each day studied in the last year, shaded by how much.

milestones.title: Milestones
milestones.about: Each milestone reached, with the day it was reached.

outcomes.title: What the study produced
outcomes.about: Cards in long-term memory, knowledge points mastered, explanations passed, questions answered and workouts.

summary.weeks_one: week in a row meeting a goal of {{goal, number}} study days
summary.weeks_other: weeks in a row meeting a goal of {{goal, number}} study days
summary.levelHow: Earned by study days; it never goes down.

share.title: Your page is public
share.draftNote: Only you can see it. Tick 'Public' and save to share it.

editor.handleNote: 3 to 30 characters: letters a to z, digits and single hyphens. Changing it later stops the old link working.
editor.name: Name shown
editor.headline: Headline
editor.headlinePlaceholder: For example: learning Spanish and data analysis
editor.published: Public: anyone with the link can see it
editor.publishedNote: Untick and save to hide it again.
editor.indexed: Let Google and other search engines show it
editor.indexedNote: While the page is public, people can find it by searching your name. Untick to share it only by its link; search engines can take a while to drop a page they already list.
editor.blocksNote: Blocks counted by AnyLearn show only what is recorded; your blocks show what you write.
editor.noBlocks: No blocks: the page shows only your name and headline.
editor.linksNote: Links open in a new tab and are marked as yours.
editor.savedDraft: Saved as a draft. Only you can see it.
editor.deleted: Page deleted. Its address is free.
editor.previewNote: As a visitor will see it, with your numbers as of now.
editor.unreadable: the page's design could not be read
editor.dropped_one: {{count, number}} block of your page could not be read by this version of AnyLearn and is left out. Saving keeps the page without it.
editor.dropped_other: {{count, number}} blocks of your page could not be read by this version of AnyLearn and are left out. Saving keeps the page without them.
editor.droppedAll: Your page's design could not be read by this version of AnyLearn, so it shows no blocks. Saving keeps the page as shown here.
editor.moved: Moved {{block}} to place {{n, number}} of {{total, number}}.

seo.description: {{name}}'s learning profile on AnyLearn: study days, streak and milestones counted from real study.

missing.title: No public profile here
missing.lede: There is no public profile at this address, or its owner has not made it public.
missing.busy: Wait a minute and try again.

delete.title: Delete the page
delete.note: The page and its address go. Your study and its numbers stay.
